Ins and Outs: Honoraria Processing
In the world of grants, honoraria refers to one-time payments made to individuals for services rendered that are not based on a contractual agreement or an employer-employee relationship. Honoraria are often provided as a token of appreciation or recognition for an individual's participation in conferences, workshops, seminars, or other events sponsored by federal grant-funded projects or organizations.
